title: Record page: a related list or rail entry bound to an object that is not installed draws a humanized raw name ("Crm Quote 0 — No related records found", "+3 empty (Crm Quote · …)")
body:
## Source

This was measured on 18.2.0 in hotcrm's module-split hard-edge ledger (`docs/architecture/module-split-hard-edges.md`, rows R18 and M12; hotcrm#2311), with a module's objects absent:

- On an opportunity record page (`opportunity_detail.page.ts`, related lists bound to `crm_quote`, `crm_opportunity_line_item` and `crm_product`), *Related* shows **"Crm Quote 0 — No related records found"**. The rail reads **"+3 empty (Crm Quote · Crm Opportunity Lin…)"**. The page logs 8 404s on `/api/v1/meta/object/…` and `/api/v1/data/…`.
- On a lead page, *Campaign Members* shows **"Crm Campaign Member 0 — No related records found"**. The console logs `[useSettledSchema] getObjectSchema failed for crm_campaign_member MetadataNotFoundError`.

The page still works. The list, though, is noise: it is labelled with a made-up name built from the raw API name, and it offers an empty list of something the install cannot have. Since ADR-0141 shipped, a module artifact can really be absent, so every app record page that names a dependent module's object will show this.

## Target

The record page leaves out a related list or rail entry whose object is not installed. It follows the same rule as `DashboardView`'s `requiresObject` / `widget.object` filter (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/DashboardView.tsx:199`) and `NavigationItem.requiresObject`. If it cannot be left out, it carries no humanized raw name and makes no 404 round trips.

## Acceptance

1. With the bound object absent, a record page draws neither the related list nor its rail entry, and makes no `/meta/object` or `/data` request for that object. A renderer test pins this.
2. With the object present, the page is unchanged.

<sub>Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` lane seat (session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`) from the ledger finding F8. A dedupe search for "related list bound to uninstalled object, humanized raw name" found nothing.</sub>
